conviction_note: Q3 2026 has not been pre-released. It was only guided at c.EUR60m (+25% YoY), twice. The release also carries the first Q4 guide and the first management comment on the Nov-2 APAC deals, so I size the move at 8% (new numbers, a guidance line, 57% realised vol). p_up is only 57 because the evidence for the sign is order intake and a peer series, not an unpublished number. Against it: Q1 2026 printed below its guide and fell, and the stock is +24% over 60 sessions. The scaled +1.1 sits below the +2.1 sum because the findings are each sized on their own and mostly lean the same way, while p_up carries the sign doubt once.

already_public.what: Q3 2026 revenue guidance c.EUR60m (+25% YoY, quarterly record), first given with the H1 pre-close

H1 2026 results: revenue EUR98.7m, adj. EBITDA EUR18.5m (18.7%), adj. NFN EUR47.7m. Q3 guide c.EUR60m confirmed. Management expects operating leverage to improve from 3Q26. Order intake +55% YoY July YTD, book-to-bill 1.4x
CEO: 2027 revenue target EUR270m, including at least EUR25m from NEURA Robotics
Refinancing: EUR115m facilities replace EUR90m of residual debt at 30 Sep; CFO puts leverage at 'circa 1x' today

Binding deals: 60% of Qiyang for EUR9m plus up to EUR3m earn-out, remaining 45% of Fannal for EUR23m (5.3x 2026 EV/EBITDA), 49% of SECO Asia for EUR3.4m. More detail promised on the 9M call, 9 Nov 14:30 CET

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue around or slightly above EUR60m (bar +0 to +3%). Q3 adj. EBITDA margin back toward 20-22% (Q3'25: 22%) on operating leverage. Small upward lean.
First Q4 2026 revenue guide (Q4'25 was EUR51.2m). Orders +55% and book-to-bill 1.4x point to c.EUR60m+ (+15-25% YoY). Possibly a restated 2027 target that includes Qiyang. Leans up, low confidence.
Adj. NFN at 30 Sep. The CFO's 'circa 1x' leverage vs 1.2x at H1 suggests stable-to-better. The memory inventory build is the risk.
Financing and accretion detail on the APAC deals, on the 14:30 CET call, inside the window

findings.finding: SECO's own H1 deck shows order intake +55% YoY July YTD (EUR155.1m vs EUR99.8m) and book-to-bill 1.4x. That backs Q3 at or above the c.EUR60m guide and a first Q4 guide well above Q4'25's EUR51.2m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 15 Jul 2026, Q2 met and Q3 EUR60m guide introduced: +6.87% then +4.19%. 11 May 2026, Q1 at the low end of its guide: -3.50% then -4.36%. This stock moves hard on its next-quarter guide.
findings.original_quote: Order intake +55% YoY and book-to-bill consistently above 1x build backlog and revenue visibility
findings.why_not_priced: The orders are public, but no Q4 number exists. SECO only guides one quarter ahead, so the Q4 level is genuinely new on 9 Nov. If a strong Q4 were priced, the stock would sit at its post-H1 high (EUR4.775, 30 Sep), not at EUR4.19 after -6% in five sessions.

findings.finding: Advantech, the largest embedded/edge-computing peer, reported Q3 2026 revenue +83% YoY on 29 Oct, with Europe 9M revenue +36% in USD and European book-to-bill rising to 1.52. That is an independent series showing the industrial edge cycle accelerating through SECO's quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed SECO reaction to peer reads. 7 Nov 2025: SECO rose +4.02% on a margin-led Q3 beat.
findings.why_not_priced: A Taiwanese peer read is rarely mapped onto an Arezzo STAR small cap. SECO rose +3.5% on 29 Oct and gave it back on 30 Oct (-4.85%), so no lasting re-rating shows on the tape. Weight is small because this is a proxy, and Advantech's growth includes US/AI-server mix that SECO lacks.
findings.independence: SECO's own order intake, a different document (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-09/20260908_188854.pdf)

findings.finding: On 13 Oct, after the quarter closed, the CFO put leverage (NFN/EBITDA) at 'circa 1x' against 1.2x LTM at H1. That points to Q3 EBITDA growth and/or deleveraging despite the H1 memory inventory build.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 7 Nov 2025: Q3 with strong margin and cash (adj. EBITDA doubled YoY), stock +4.02% on the day.
findings.original_quote: SECO ha ridotto il proprio Financial leverage, ossia il rapporto fra l'Indebitamento Finanziario Netto e il Margine Operativo Lordo, da oltre 3x dell'ottobre 2021 a circa 1x di oggi.
findings.why_not_priced: The line sits in the body of an Italian refinancing release headlined on the bank deal, not on Q3 cash. No preview reads it as a Q3 datapoint, and the stock fell 1.15% that day. It is a rounded soundbite, so it is small.

findings.finding: The 2 Nov APAC deals add Qiyang (2025 revenue c.EUR12m, 2026 forecast +50%, c.15% EBITDA margin) and buy out Fannal's 45% minority at 5.3x 2026 EV/EBITDA (Fannal EBITDA EUR7.7m). Management will give detail on the 9 Nov call and may lift the EUR270m 2027 target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stock flat on 2 Nov (0.00%), +5.32% on 3 Nov, -8.63% on 4 Nov with no filing to explain it.
findings.original_quote: Il corrispettivo implica un multiplo EV/EBITDA 2026 pari a circa 5,3x ... Consentirà inoltre agli azionisti di SECO di beneficiare pienamente degli utili della controllata.
findings.why_not_priced: The deals are public, but their effect on the 2027 target and on net profit attributable to the group is not quantified yet. That comes on the call. The financing (c.EUR35m of commitments, spread to end-2027) is covered by the EUR115m facility signed 13 Oct, which includes a capex/M&A line, so it reads as funding growth, not distress.
findings.independence: EUR115m refinancing with a dedicated growth line (https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-10/20261013_190550.pdf)

findings.finding: Component-cost pressure on the margin: Advantech cites rising key-component costs for a YoY gross-margin decline. SECO's own H1 adj. EBITDA margin fell to 18.7% from 20.5% on personnel costs for the new plant. Q3 EBITDA could therefore lag the revenue step-up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 8 Sep 2026: H1 EBITDA down 8% was overshadowed by NEURA (+14.06%). 11 May 2026: Q1 with a lower margin, -3.50%.
findings.original_quote: Il contributo positivo derivante dall'espansione del Gross margin è stato compensato dall'incremento del costo del personale, dovuto ad assunzioni mirate nelle funzioni di Ricerca & Sviluppo e Operations
findings.why_not_priced: There is no sourced Q3 EBITDA consensus, so the bar is unsourced and the finding is capped small. SECO pre-bought memory in H1 and passes costs through (Q2 gross margin 56%), which offsets part of the risk.
findings.independence: Advantech Q3 2026 gross margin down YoY on component costs (https://www.advantech.com/pt-br/resources/news/advantech-reports-3q26-eps-of-nt715)

baseline_tension: Mild positive, against a 5-day run-up of -6.2% that leaves room. The +24% over 60 days and the Q1 sell-off on a miss argue that a merely in-line EUR60m is not enough, which is why p_up stays at 57.
language_note: The CFO's 'circa 1x' leverage line, after the quarter closed, appeared only in the Italian refinancing release body. No English wire carried it.
Release timestamps (11:38-11:42 board-day filings), which settle the session, came from the Italian eMarket STORAGE headers.
The CEO's EUR270m 2027 target with NEURA was reported by Milano Finanza, with no English-language equivalent found.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes: median 9.0%; guidance findings 11 of 17 on sign): the order-intake / first-Q4-guide finding was resized on the guidance scale, +0.8 to +1.2. abs_move_pct went 7.0 to 8.0, because a first Q4 guide is a scheduled guidance event.
'Too small about the move' (18 of 23 under, by about 3x): abs_move_pct was not capped at the name's estimated 3.1% history; it sits at 8.0. p_up is unchanged at 57.
'Already told is worth 0': confirmed Q3 was not pre-released. The EUR60m guide itself is treated as the bar, not a finding.
